title: Adam Robinson on founder-led LinkedIn growth: content schedule, ghostwriters, and inbound-led outbound
summary: Adam walks through his actual weekly calendar, showing most of a CEO's week going to content and podcasts. He explains why organic founder content beats paid ads, how to start (ghostwriter, study creators, comment thoughtfully), why he runs on gut over metrics, and how to follow up with website visitors.

principles.text: Organic founder content can beat any ad budget for building awareness and trust, when your buyers live on that platform.
principles.quote: I have developed more trust and the awareness is higher than any AD campaign or sponsorship or whatever I could have done with that money

principles.text: Get a ghostwriter first and learn by watching; only take over writing once you catch the content bug.
principles.quote: start with a Ghost Rider work with them for a few months they can help you with some of this stuff right like if they understand what you do what might what might you write about

principles.text: Make people feel they know you like a friend; that human connection is what survives commoditized software.
principles.quote: I believe that it's making people feel like they know me like a friend so I'm trying to use that as like a fundamental principle in how I'm presenting myself on LinkedIn

principles.text: Early on, run content on gut; the most important things can't be measured and metrics-driven teams overweight the measurable.
principles.quote: I do worry that like the most important things cannot be measured and when you get people in who are running your entire company on metrics the most important things uh lose relative value to the things that are far less important but you can measure

principles.text: Study top creators in your own space to learn why posts work, and comment thoughtfully on a small list of ecosystem peers.
principles.quote: I think if you have a list of 10 people in your space and you spend a few days a week commenting on their stuff they might start commenting on your stuff and you will slowly become known in the ecosystem that way

principles.text: Follow up with website visitors within single-digit hours, using the same playbook you use for outbound demos.
principles.quote: I think there's some magic amount of time you should wait like in the number in the single digit hours right and you can automate all of this
